claims.claim: Direct Japan (implying imported used engine from Japan)
claims.evidence: No import stamps, Japan auction sheet, or documentation visible in the photo; origin cannot be confirmed remotely.
No receipt, warranty card, or seller shop signage shown; a verbal guarantee claim has no photographic proof.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or start
risks.proof: Video clip of engine starting and idling, ideally with sound and exhaust visible

risks.risk: Unknown make, model, and displacement means wrong part could be bought
risks.proof: Close-up photo of engine ID plate/stamped engine number
risks.if_unproven: price as unidentified generic used engine, lowest bracket for 'engine assembly' category

risks.risk: Unknown mileage/hours and true mechanical condition
risks.proof: Odometer photo from donor vehicle or compression/leak-down test results

risks.risk: Reason for removal unknown (accident, internal fault, engine swap)
risks.proof: Photos of the donor vehicle or seller's explicit removal reason with supporting image

risks.risk: Incompleteness - missing ancillary parts (starter, alternator, ECU, loom, mounts)
risks.proof: Full-angle photos showing all four sides of engine with ancillary parts labeled
risks.if_unproven: price as bare long block only, excluding ancillaries

risks.risk: Guarantee claim may be unenforceable or fake
risks.proof: Photo of written guarantee/receipt with shop name, date, and terms
risks.if_unproven: price as sold with no warranty

proof_requests: Close-up of engine ID/serial number plate
Video of engine starting and running
Photos of donor vehicle (if available) or chassis/engine number match
All-angle photos showing completeness of ancillary parts
Photo of any written guarantee/receipt document
Compression or leak-down test video if possible
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a used, removed car engine assembly, which can be priced at worst case (unidentified model, unverified running condition, unverified guarantee), with upside proof requests listed to justify any higher price.
